site: Argus restream test site (WebRTC live + main-stream recording over the RTSP replay harness)
_doc: Two replay cameras from tools/rtsp_replay.ps1: analytics read <name>_sub, the restreamer pulls <name> (the main stream, H.264 without B-frames, keyframe every 2 s). ${RTSP_USER}, ${RTSP_PASSWORD}, ${RTSP_HOST} and ${MEDIAMTX_BIN} are PLACEHOLDERS: copy this file to configs/restream_site.local.json (git-ignored) and replace them (README 'Smooth live view and main-stream recording' has a PowerShell one-liner). The restreamer is a SECOND MediaMTX that Argus starts itself (API 127.0.0.1:9987, WHEP 127.0.0.1:8889, ICE/UDP 8189), separate from the replay harness (RTSP :8554, API :9997). 'street' (main: copy of the Kaggle clip) is left out on purpose: its H.264 may contain B-frames, which WebRTC cannot play.
